text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, she's always messing around,
but she really takes her running seriously...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Especially that late charge around the bend—
I knew it'd turn into a real close contest.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that? That's a technique
my Trainer sealed away from me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
He told me, "Don't you dare use it,"
so I went ahead and used it! Take that!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Every time we train, it's "don't use that,"
"don't use this"...
Man, they just never shut up, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Every single training session?
Just how many sealed techniques do you have?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Big and small combined, there are well over 700 of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So, which of those techniques
haven't you tried yet...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Zero, obviously!
Tell me not to use it, and that just makes me wanna use it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(A chemical reaction between sensible guidance and a contrarian nature
has given birth to a versatile running style... huh.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well now... Your Trainer is surprisingly interesting, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! That's someone I handpicked myself!
Things are only gonna get more interesting from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, without even realizing it herself, Gold Ship was steadily growing stronger."
